# PanePilot v0.13.0

PanePilot 0.13.0 improves attention accuracy and makes the compact toolbar easier to
personalize.

## Highlights

- Codex terminals now surface a queued follow-up question as **Needs input** even when
  the pane title still says Working. Attached terminals update from their live screen;
  detached local or SSH panes are checked through bounded, rotating read-only captures.
- Pinned top-toolbar actions can be reordered by dragging or with Option/Alt-Left/Right. Their
  client-local order persists across restarts without changing the overflow menu.
- The obsolete Terminal/LaTeX type switcher has been removed from the top bar; project
  type remains available when creating a project, and the dangerous-mode indicator is
  now labeled **YOLO agent**.

## Download

The attached DMG and ZIP support Apple silicon Macs running macOS 12 or newer.
`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains SHA-256 checksums for both downloads. PanePilot has no
automatic update channel; install new versions from this repository.

PanePilot Remote for Android remains available as source under `android/`; this
release does not include a signed Android APK.

Stable latest-release link: [github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest](https://github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest)

## First launch

This desktop build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized. After copying
PanePilot to Applications, Control-click it in Finder, choose **Open**, and confirm
the launch. Do not disable Gatekeeper. Download PanePilot artifacts only from this
GitHub repository.
